summary: @servicetitan/cp-ui preinstall dropper: downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json sets scripts.preinstall to 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads a Bun binary from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses execFileSync to run the shipped math_init.js under it. math_init.js is a single-line 727KB '@bun @bun-cjs' bundle with hex-obfuscated identifiers and a WV8StW string-array-rotation dispatcher over a 1200+ entry constant table. Fetching an alternate language runtime and using it to auto-execute an opaque in-tarball payload during `npm install` is not consistent with the package's advertised purpose as a React UI component library; the runtime download is used specifically to run opaque code outside Node's normal instrumentation. Dependency metadata (@servicetitan/design-system, react-pdf, formstate) is consistent with a legitimate UI library, but the preinstall dropper and obfuscated payload are inconsistent with that surface and consistent with a hijacked/impersonated release of the @servicetitan scope.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
